title: Drawing Skills: Marks & Lines
welcome_lead: Pencils, pens and charcoal — learn the marks that build every drawing.
meta_desc: KS3 drawing: pencil grades, line types, hatching and basic mark-making.
final_note: Strong drawings start with confident, varied marks.

walkthroughs.body_html: Pencils are graded from 9H (very hard, pale) to 9B (very soft, dark). HB sits in the middle. Hard pencils give crisp light lines for plans; soft pencils give rich darks for shading.
Hatching is parallel lines, close together for dark areas. Cross-hatching adds more layers at different angles to deepen tone. Stippling uses dots — more dots equal darker tone.
A contour line describes the edge of an object slowly and carefully. A gesture drawing is fast and loose, capturing energy in 30 seconds. Both train your eye to see shape and movement.
